achievements.name: Lilac and Gooseberries
achievements.description: Find Yennefer of Vengerberg.

steps: Finish the White Orchard prologue and travel to Velen.
Progress the main quest until you reunite with Yennefer (Lilac and Gooseberries questline).

achievements.name: Butcher of Blaviken
achievements.description: Kill at least 5 opponents in under 10 seconds.

steps: Kill at least 5 opponents in under 10 seconds.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: Fist of the South Star
achievements.description: Defeat an opponent in a fistfight without taking any damage.

steps: Find fistfight tournament / challenger NPCs in taverns and notice boards.
Win a fistfight without taking any damage — keep blocks high and counter.

achievements.name: Let's Cook!
achievements.description: Learn 12 potion formulae.

steps: Open the Alchemy menu and learn a potion, oil, or bomb formula from a recipe.
Craft that mixture at a campfire / alchemy surface.

achievements.name: Can't Touch This!
achievements.description: Kill 5 foes in a fight without taking damage (except for Toxicity) and without using the Quen Sign.

steps: Kill an enemy using only your fists (no sword/signs finishing if it blocks progress).
Easiest on a weak drowners / bandits after leveling a bit.

achievements.name: Bookworm
achievements.description: Read 30 books, journals or other documents.

steps: Read books and documents from loot, vendors, and quest rewards.
Read 30 different books/documents total.

achievements.name: Family Counselor
achievements.description: Find the baron's wife and daughter.

steps: Complete the Bloody Baron questline in Velen (Family Matters).
Find Anna and Tamara to finish the baron’s family subplot.
warnings: Some outcomes change based on your choices with the Whispering Hillock — finish Family Matters carefully.

achievements.name: Friends With Benefits
achievements.description: Complete the subplot involving Keira Metz.

steps: Complete Keira Metz’s side quests in Velen (including For the Advancement of Learning).
Send her to Kaer Morhen when given the choice — do not kill her or leave her hostile.
warnings: Missable. Killing Keira or failing her questline locks this out for the playthrough.

achievements.name: Bombardier
achievements.description: Collect the formulae for 6 different bomb types.

steps: Buy or loot bomb recipes from herbalists and quest rewards.
Learn formulae for 6 different bomb types in the Alchemy panel.

achievements.name: Triple Threat
achievements.description: Kill 3 opponents in one fight using 3 different methods (swords, bombs, crossbow, Signs, etc.).

steps: In one combat encounter, kill three enemies using three different method categories.
Example mix: sword kill + Igni/Aard kill + bomb or crossbow kill before the fight fully ends.

achievements.name: A Friend in Need
achievements.description: Find and free Dandelion.

steps: Follow the Novigrad main quests hunting for Dandelion.
Complete the quest chain that frees him (Get Junior / Count Reuven’s Treasure path).

achievements.name: Shrieker
achievements.description: Complete the contract on the shrieker.

steps: Find the notice-board contract for the shrieker and accept it.
Track the quest, kill the target, and turn the contract in.

achievements.name: Necromancer
achievements.description: Help Yennefer extract information from Skjall's body.

steps: In Skellige, continue Yennefer’s questline after finding Skjall.
Help her perform the necromancy ritual on Skjall’s body.

achievements.name: Environmentally Unfriendly
achievements.description: Kill 50 opponents using the environment (e.g. swamp gas, insects or objects).

steps: Detonate swamp gas with Igni, knock foes into spikes, or use nest insects.
Get 50 environmental kills total.

achievements.name: Mutant
achievements.description: Fill all mutagen slots.

steps: Unlock mutagen slots via ability points / Greater Mutagens progression.
Fill every mutagen slot on the character panel at once.

achievements.name: Fire in the Hole
achievements.description: Destroy 10 monster nests using bombs.

steps: Destroy 10 monster nests using bombs.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: Kingmaker
achievements.description: Complete the subplot about choosing Skellige's ruler.

steps: In Skellige, complete the quests that decide the next ruler (Clan an Craite / Tuirseach path).
Finish Coronation / King’s Gambit outcomes so a ruler is chosen.

achievements.name: Something More
achievements.description: Find Ciri.

steps: Push the main story through Skellige and related Ciri flashbacks.
Reach the story beat where you finally catch up with Ciri.

achievements.name: Globetrotter
achievements.description: Discover 100 fast travel points.

steps: Explore Velen, Novigrad, Skellige, and expansions; approach signposts.
Discover 100 fast travel points.

achievements.name: Munchkin
achievements.description: Reach character development level 35.

steps: Complete quests and kill enemies for XP.
Reach character level 35.

achievements.name: The Doppler Effect
achievements.description: Resolve the doppler problem in Novigrad.

steps: Resolve the doppler problem in Novigrad.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: Xenonaut
achievements.description: Visit Tir ná Lia and convince Ge'els to betray Eredin.

steps: Progress the main quest until you travel to Tir ná Lia.
Convince Ge’els to turn against Eredin during the audience.

achievements.name: Fearless Vampire Slayer
achievements.description: Complete the contract on Sarasti.

steps: Find the notice-board contract for Sarasti and accept it.
Track the quest, kill the target, and turn the contract in.

achievements.name: The King is Dead
achievements.description: Defeat Eredin.

steps: Reach the final battles of the main story.
Defeat Eredin in the endgame confrontation.

achievements.name: Passed the Trial
achievements.description: Finish the game on any difficulty.

steps: Play through the main story on the required difficulty.
Finish the game on any difficulty.

achievements.name: Ashes to Ashes
achievements.description: Complete the contract on Therazane.

steps: Find the notice-board contract for Therazane and accept it.
Track the quest, kill the target, and turn the contract in.

achievements.name: The Witcher's Gone South
achievements.description: Travel to the Duchy of Toussaint.

steps: Travel to the Duchy of Toussaint.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: Full Crew
achievements.description: Bring all possible allies to Kaer Morhen for the battle against the Hunt.

steps: Before the Battle of Kaer Morhen, recruit every available ally (Keira, Letho if alive, Ermion, etc.).
Complete their prerequisite quests so they appear at the keep.
warnings: Missable. Several allies require side quests finished before the point of no return.

achievements.name: I'm Not Kissing That
achievements.description: Kill the prince cursed into a toad.

steps: Kill the prince cursed into a toad.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: Fiend or Foe?
achievements.description: Complete the contract on Morvudd.

steps: Find the notice-board contract for Morvudd and accept it.
Track the quest, kill the target, and turn the contract in.

achievements.name: Armed and Dangerous
achievements.description: Find and equip all the elements of one set of witcher gear.

steps: Find and equip all the elements of one set of witcher gear.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: Geralt and Friends
achievements.description: Win a round of gwent using only neutral cards.

steps: Open a gwent match against an NPC or in a tournament.
Win a round of gwent using only neutral cards.

achievements.name: Pacta Sunt Servanda
achievements.description: Finish the "Hearts of Stone" expansion.

steps: Start the expansion questline from the main menu / notice.
Play through until the expansion credits.

achievements.name: Brawler
achievements.description: Defeat Olaf, the Skellige champion of unarmed combat.

steps: Defeat Olaf, the Skellige champion of unarmed combat.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: All In
achievements.description: Play three hero cards in one round of gwent and win the match.

steps: Open a gwent match against an NPC or in a tournament.
Play three hero cards in one round of gwent and win the match.

achievements.name: Assassin of Kings
achievements.description: Take part in the assassination of King Radovid.

steps: In Novigrad/Radovid political quests, side with Dijkstra/Roche path that targets Radovid.
Participate in the assassination sequence Reason of State.
warnings: Missable. Requires specific political choices; opposing paths skip the assassination.

achievements.name: Weapon "W"
achievements.description: Develop a mutation.

steps: Develop a mutation.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: Brawl Master
achievements.description: Complete all fistfighting quests in Velen, Skellige and Novigrad.

steps: Complete fistfight questlines in Velen, Novigrad, and Skellige (notice boards / taverns).
Finish every fistfighting quest in those regions.

achievements.name: Rad Steez, Bro!
achievements.description: Slide downhill uninterrupted for at least 10 seconds.

steps: Find a long steep slope (Skellige mountains work well).
Sprint into a slide and stay sliding downhill for 10+ seconds without stopping.

achievements.name: Playing House
achievements.description: Use all available options for developing Corvo Bianco.

steps: Use all available options for developing Corvo Bianco.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: Last Action Hero
achievements.description: Be decorated with the Order of Vitis Vinifera.

steps: Be decorated with the Order of Vitis Vinifera.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: Woodland Spirit
achievements.description: Complete the contract on the Woodland Spirit.

steps: Find the notice-board contract for the Woodland Spirit and accept it.
Track the quest, kill the target, and turn the contract in.

achievements.name: Embodiment of the Five Virtues
achievements.description: Be given Aerondight by the Lady of the Lake.

steps: In Blood and Wine, uphold the five chivalric virtues during Toussaint quests.
Complete the Lady of the Lake / Aerondight trial so she awards the sword.
warnings: Failing virtue checks can lock Aerondight — use a guide checklist for virtue moments.

achievements.name: A Knight to Remember
achievements.description: Obtain a flawless victory in all the competitions during the knights' tourney.

steps: Enter the knights’ tourney in Toussaint.
Win every competition without failing any event for a flawless run.

achievements.name: Gwent Master
achievements.description: Defeat Tybalt and win the gwent tournament held at the Passiflora.

steps: Open a gwent match against an NPC or in a tournament.
Defeat Tybalt and win the gwent tournament held at the Passiflora.

achievements.name: Curator of Nightmares
achievements.description: Recreate all of Iris' nightmares in the Painted World.

steps: In the Painted World (Hearts of Stone), interact with Iris’s memories/nightmares.
Recreate every nightmare scene before finishing the area.

achievements.name: Geralt: The Professional
achievements.description: Complete all witcher contracts.

steps: Clear every ? witcher contract marker on the base-game maps (White Orchard, Velen, Novigrad, Skellige).
Finish each contract quest in your journal — DLC contracts are separate.

achievements.name: Fast and Furious
achievements.description: Win all the horse races in the game.

steps: Win all the horse races in the game.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: Shopaholic
achievements.description: Buy all the items put on the block at the Borsodis' Auction House.

steps: During Hearts of Stone, attend the Borsodis’ Auction House sequence.
Buy every lot put up for auction (bring crowns).
warnings: Missable in that auction scene — reload a save if you skipped lots.

achievements.name: The Grapes of Wrath Stomped
achievements.description: Help unite the warring vineyards and have a wine named in your honor.

steps: Complete the Blood and Wine vineyard war side content (Coronata / Vermentino).
Unite the vineyards so a wine is named after Geralt.

achievements.name: Dressed to Kill
achievements.description: Unlock the bonus for equipping all the witcher gear elements from one School.

steps: Unlock the bonus for equipping all the witcher gear elements from one School.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: Even Odds
achievements.description: Kill 2 monsters you have a contract on without using Signs, potions, mutagens, oils or bombs.

steps: Take a monster contract, then fight the target with no Signs, potions, mutagens, oils, or bombs.
Do this on 2 different contract monsters.

achievements.name: Let the Good Times Roll!
achievements.description: Participate in all the activities at the wedding.

steps: During the Hearts of Stone wedding at the Estate.
Join every minigame/activity available before leaving the party.

achievements.name: Pest Control
achievements.description: Destroy all monster nests in the Velen / Novigrad region, or in Skellige.

steps: Destroy all monster nests in the Velen / Novigrad region, or in Skellige.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: Dendrologist
achievements.description: Acquire all the Abilities in one tree.

steps: Acquire all the Abilities in one tree.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: Turned Every Stone
achievements.description: Find all grandmaster diagrams for each witcher school.

steps: Find all grandmaster diagrams for each witcher school.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: I Have a Gwent Problem
achievements.description: Collect all the cards in the Skellige deck.

steps: Collect all the cards in the Skellige deck.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: Wild Rose Dethorned
achievements.description: Defeat all the fallen knights and loot their campsites.

steps: Defeat all the fallen knights and loot their campsites.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: Ran the Gauntlet
achievements.description: Finish the game on the "Blood and Broken Bones!" or "Death March!" difficulty levels.

steps: Play on Blood and Broken Bones! or Death March! from the start.
Finish the main story on that difficulty.

achievements.name: Killed It
achievements.description: Win a round of gwent with a total strength of at least 187.

steps: Open a gwent match against an NPC or in a tournament.
Win a round of gwent with a total strength of at least 187.

achievements.name: Power Overwhelming
achievements.description: Have all possible Place of Power bonuses active at the same time.

steps: Activate every Place of Power on the map (draw ability points from the glowing pillars).
Have all Place of Power bonuses active at once — revisit any that expired if needed.

achievements.name: Card Collector
achievements.description: Acquire all gwent cards available in the base version of the game.

steps: Play gwent against merchants, innkeeps, and unique NPCs across the base game.
Buy remaining cards from traders; use a checklist for missable unique cards (e.g. certain quest NPCs).
warnings: Some unique cards are missable if quest NPCs die or leave before you play them.

achievements.name: Kaer Morhen Trained
achievements.description: Perform 10 effective counterattacks in a row without getting hit or parrying.

steps: Perform 10 effective counterattacks in a row without getting hit or parrying.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: Can Quit Anytime I Want
achievements.description: Be under the influence of seven potions or decoctions at the same time.

steps: Be under the influence of seven potions or decoctions at the same time.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: Walked the Path
achievements.description: Finish the game on the "Death March!" difficulty level.

steps: Start a new game (or NG+) on Death March! difficulty.
Finish the entire main story without lowering difficulty.
warnings: Changing difficulty down can void Death March credit — stay on Death March the whole run.

achievements.name: Return to Sender
achievements.description: Kill 3 opponents with their own arrows.

steps: Fight human archers; use Aard or timing to make their arrows hit them, or the reflecting skill/setup that counts.
Kill 3 opponents with their own arrows.

achievements.name: David and Golyat
achievements.description: Kill Golyat with a crossbow bolt to his eye.

steps: Find the giant Golyat in Toussaint.
Shoot a crossbow bolt into his eye to kill him (aim for the glowing weak spot).

achievements.name: That Is the Evilest Thing
achievements.description: Ignite the gas produced by a Dragon's Dream bomb using a burning opponent. Do this 10 times.

steps: Throw a Dragon’s Dream bomb to create gas.
Ignite it by hitting a burning enemy (Igni or burning oil) — repeat 10 times.

achievements.name: Overkill
achievements.description: Make an opponent suffer from bleeding, poisoning and burning simultaneously. Do this 10 times.

steps: Make an opponent suffer from bleeding, poisoning and burning simultaneously. Do this 10 times.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: What Was That?
achievements.description: Attack, counter, cast a Sign and throw a bomb (in any order) in under 4 seconds.

steps: In combat, quickly: light attack, counter, cast any Sign, and throw a bomb.
Land all four actions within 4 seconds (any order).

achievements.name: Kling of the Clink
achievements.description: Serve time in Toussaint.

steps: In Toussaint, get arrested (or choose the path that jails Geralt).
Serve the prison sequence to unlock the achievement.

achievements.name: Moo-rderer
achievements.description: Kill 20 cows.

steps: Find cows in fields (White Orchard / Velen).
Kill 20 cows total — a panicking herd makes this fast.

achievements.name: I Wore Ofieri Before It Was Cool
achievements.description: Collect all available Ofieri armor and horse gear, and at least one Ofieri sword.

steps: Collect all available Ofieri armor and horse gear, and at least one Ofieri sword.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: The Enemy of My Enemy
achievements.description: Use the Axii Sign to force one opponent to kill another. Do this 20 times.

steps: Use the Axii Sign to force one opponent to kill another. Do this 20 times.
Use the quest journal and map filters if the target is location-gated.

achievements.name: When It's Many Against One…
achievements.description: Provoke all Iris von Everec's Nightmares into fighting you at the same time and defeat them.

steps: In Iris’s realm, provoke/aggro all Nightmares so they fight you together.
Defeat the full group in one encounter.

achievements.name: Hasta la Vista™
achievements.description: Kill a frozen opponent with a crossbow bolt.

steps: Freeze an enemy (Northern Wind bomb or similar freeze effect).
While they are frozen, kill them with a crossbow bolt.

achievements.name: Humpty Dumpty
achievements.description: Kill 10 opponents by knocking them off somewhere high with the Aard Sign.

steps: Find enemies on cliffs or ledges.
Use Aard to knock 10 of them to their death from height.

achievements.name: Master Marksman
achievements.description: Kill 50 human and nonhuman opponents by striking them in the head with a crossbow bolt.

steps: Equip a crossbow and aim for heads on humans/nonhumans.
Get 50 crossbow headshot kills.
